guarantees: company_id is required and enrichment never crosses company boundaries
canonical entity identity is referenced, never rewritten by enrichment
each enrichment fact has source provenance, observed/retrieved timestamps, confidence and freshness
raw source values and normalized/derived values remain distinguishable
conflicting facts are retained and surfaced rather than silently overwritten
provider precedence is explicit and field-scoped; authority is not inferred from source class alone
knowledge authority contributes policies, constraints and interpretations but does not manufacture execution authority
financial and environmental context remain evidence/context until a governed decision consumes them
stale context remains traceable and can be excluded by policy without deletion
